analytic_claims_to_document: For fixed SPD A=M^-1 and B=UAU^T, f(t)=[det(M)det(tA+(1-t)B)]^-1/2 has every even derivative nonnegative by differentiating its dominated Gaussian integral.

The 8-node Lobatto Hermite interpolant matches two endpoints and function/first derivative at six interior roots. f-H = f^(14)(xi)/14! * t(t-1) prod(t-ti)^2 <=0, hence its positive-weight rule is an upper bound without a derivative-size estimate.
Original measure is Beta(5/4,5/4). Modified measure t(1-t)mu normalized is Beta(9/4,9/4), normalization 5/28. Six Gaussian nodes yield exact Lobatto moments through degree13.

Positive weights and 0<f<=1 yield 0<r_true<=r_Lobatto<=1 for every SPD shape; old integrable determinant moment still dominates all near-degenerate shapes. R expectation remains uncomputed and uncertified.
